examples.text: Psychologists and collectors have different opinions（opinion的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 心理学家和收藏者有着不同的看法。
examples.speechText: Psychologists and collectors have different opinions.

examples.text: You’ll be fined unless you return the books to the school library by this weekend.
examples.translation: 除非你在本周末之前把书归还学校图书馆，否则就会被罚款。
examples.speechText: You’ll be fined unless you return the books to the school library by this weekend.

examples.text: Thousands（thousand的复数形式） of years ago, humans collected nuts and fruits.
examples.translation: 几千年前，人类采集坚果和水果。
examples.speechText: Thousands of years ago, humans collected nuts and fruits.

examples.text: Talk to your students before and after class, walk up and down the stairs when you teach your class rather than stay on the stage.
examples.translation: 课前课后与学生交谈；上课时在阶梯教室的台阶间走动，而不要一直待在讲台上。
examples.speechText: Talk to your students before and after class, walk up and down the stairs when you teach your class rather than stay on the stage.

examples.text: You’ll be fined unless you return the books to the school library by this weekend.
examples.translation: 除非你在本周末之前把书归还学校图书馆，否则就会被罚款。
examples.speechText: You’ll be fined unless you return the books to the school library by this weekend.

examples.text: As a result, any lessening of their partner’s（partner的所有格形式） attention may be thought of as rejection or abandonment.
examples.translation: 因此，伴侣给予的关注稍有减少，都可能被视为拒绝或抛弃。
examples.speechText: As a result, any lessening of their partner’s attention may be thought of as rejection or abandonment.

examples.text: We can’t simply judge a person by his voice, nor can we neglect intonation.
examples.translation: 我们不能仅凭一个人的声音来判断他，也不能忽视语调。
examples.speechText: We can’t simply judge a person by his voice, nor can we neglect intonation.

examples.text: I immediately bought a used manual typewriter and felt like a genuine writer.
examples.translation: 我立刻买了一台二手手动打字机，觉得自己像个真正的作家了。
examples.speechText: I immediately bought a used manual typewriter and felt like a genuine writer.

examples.text: He would greet me every morning with head rubs.
examples.translation: 每天早晨，它都会用头蹭我，向我打招呼。
examples.speechText: He would greet me every morning with head rubs.

examples.text: “It’s like water turning from a liquid to a solid form,” says Katsuhiro Nishinari, a physicist at the University of Tokyo.
examples.translation: “这就像水从液体变成固体一样。”东京大学的物理学家西成活裕说道。
examples.speechText: “It’s like water turning from a liquid to a solid form,” says Katsuhiro Nishinari, a physicist at the University of Tokyo.

examples.text: The creation and accidental release of extremely poisonous microbes, however, is only one cause for alarm.
examples.translation: 然而，制造出剧毒微生物并使其意外泄漏，仅仅是令人担忧的原因之一。
examples.speechText: The creation and accidental release of extremely poisonous microbes, however, is only one cause for alarm.

examples.text: Adopting healthy everyday habits means your body is in better condition to fight off potential attacks（attack的复数形式） by germs and combat an illness more effectively if you do get sick.
examples.translation: 养成健康的生活习惯，意味着你的身体更有能力抵御病菌的攻击，并在生病时更有效地对抗疾病。
examples.speechText: Adopting healthy everyday habits means your body is in better condition to fight off potential attacks by germs and combat an illness more effectively if you do get sick.

examples.text: Nobody will think what you say is foolish.
examples.translation: 没有人会认为你说的话是愚蠢的。
examples.speechText: Nobody will think what you say is foolish.

examples.text: According to Simon Ingram, humpback whales rely on their songs for their survival and recovery.
examples.translation: 根据西蒙·英格拉姆的说法，座头鲸依靠它们的歌声来维持生存并实现恢复。
examples.speechText: According to Simon Ingram, humpback whales rely on their songs for their survival and recovery.

examples.text: They speak of what the New York Times calls "metal-hungry microbes that might be used to mine valuable trace metals from ocean water".
examples.translation: 他们谈到了《纽约时报》所称的“可能用于从海水中开采有价值的微量金属的嗜金属微生物”。
examples.speechText: They speak of what the New York Times calls "metal-hungry microbes that might be used to mine valuable trace metals from ocean water".
